parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true and reside in the same test file 'Shared/Playback/Tests/MP3StreamerTests/AudioEnginePlayerTests.swift' within the Playback package. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.778 suggests structural overlap between testInstallRenderTapBeforePlayMarksPending (line 36) and testRenderTapReinstalledAfterRecovery (line 395), test methods intentionally exercise distinct behavioural scenarios — pending-tap installation vs. tap reinstallation after recovery — and their structural resemblance is a natural consequence of testing the same subsystem.
